info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v4-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the removal of withdrawal requests associated with an investment portfolio. By utilizing this endpoint, users can effectively manage and retract their withdrawal activities, ensuring their investment strategies remain aligned with changing financial needs. The primary resource linked to this operation is the investment portfolio's withdrawal requests. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and investment platforms that require dynamic control over transaction modifications.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw funds from their portfolio, enabling them to access their investments. Ensure to verify the withdrawal amount and provide necessary confirmation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the necessary parameters for withdrawing funds from a portfolio. Please ensure that all required fields are accurately populated to process the withdrawal.

200.description: The withdrawal request was successfully processed.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: The JSON string representation of the request body for withdrawing from a portfolio operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.title: Withdraw Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdraw operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the withdraw operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result returned from the withdraw operation.

state.description: The current state of the withdraw operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the withdraw operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the withdraw operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the withdraw operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.description: This schema defines the response structure for a successful withdraw operation. It includes the status of the operation, reference number, result ID, state, processing time, message, and audit details.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: This schema captures the audit information for the withdraw operation, including who created it, when it was created, and whether it was automated.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value can help in diagnosing response time and performance issues.
